## Overview

This document provides a living synthesis of quantitative findings on catecholamine effects across cognitive domains. We integrate data from multiple sources (tables, supplementary materials, digitized curves), normalize them into a unified dataset, and analyze effects across:

- Attention
- Working Memory
- Cognitive Flexibility
- Salience Processing
- Mood and Motivation

{{< include ../protocol/PROTOCOL.md >}}

## Data and Provenance

Raw data extractions are maintained as immutable files in `data/raw/`. The master dataset is generated from these raw files using automated scripts and saved to `data/derived/master_dataset.parquet`.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path.cwd().parents[0]
df = pd.read_parquet(ROOT / "data" / "derived" / "master_dataset.parquet")
df.head()
```

```{python}
# generate small report tables used below
import subprocess

result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "scripts/build_reports.py"],
    cwd=ROOT,
    check=False,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)
if result.returncode != 0:
    print("Error: build_reports.py failed with exit code", result.returncode)
    if result.stdout:
        print("--- build_reports.py stdout ---")
        print(result.stdout)
    if result.stderr:
        print("--- build_reports.py stderr ---")
        print(result.stderr)
```

## Example Figure: Biomarker vs Behavior

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import numpy as np

beh = df[df["measure_kind"] == "behavior"][
    ["paper_key", "study_id", "effect_value", "measure_name"]
].rename(columns={"effect_value": "behavior_d", "measure_name": "behavior_measure"})

bio = df[df["measure_kind"] == "biomarker"][
    ["paper_key", "study_id", "effect_value", "measure_name"]
].rename(columns={"effect_value": "biomarker_d", "measure_name": "biomarker_measure"})

merged = beh.merge(bio, on=["paper_key", "study_id"], how="inner")

plt.figure()
plt.scatter(merged["biomarker_d"], merged["behavior_d"])
plt.xlabel("biomarker effect (d)")
plt.ylabel("behavior effect (d)")
plt.title("behavior vs biomarker effect sizes (paired by study_id)")
plt.show()

merged.head()
```
